title: Beyond Channel Data: Configuration-Enriched Radio Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes incorporating channel configuration (CFG) information into Radio Foundation Model (RFM) pre-training and demonstrates that the resulting CFG-enriched embeddings serve as effective inductive priors for downstream tasks under label scarcity. We compare the proposed embeddings with raw channel tokens and multiple baseline models, under three different data regimes, for multiple downstream tasks --- Line-of-Sight/Non-Line-of-Sight (LoS/NLoS) classification, timing advance (TA) estimation, and beam selection. Evaluation is done in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution configuration settings. Experimental outcomes show that the proposed embeddings consistently outperform and/or are competitive to the baselines, across experiments in both seen and unseen configuration scenarios.

translated_title: 超越信道数据：配置增强的无线基础模型
translated_abstract: 本文提出将信道配置（CFG）信息纳入无线基础模型（RFM）的预训练中，并证明由此得到的CFG增强嵌入在标签稀缺的情况下可作为下游任务的有效归纳先验。我们在三种不同的数据条件下，针对多个下游任务——视距/非视距（LoS/NLoS）分类、定时提前量（TA）估计和波束选择，将所提出的嵌入与原始信道标记以及多个基线模型进行了比较。评估在分布内和分布外的配置设置下均进行了实验。实验结果表明，在已见和未见配置场景的各项实验中，所提出的嵌入始终优于基线模型和/或与基线模型具有竞争力。
tldr: 本文提出在无线基础模型预训练中融入信道配置信息，实验证明所得的配置增强嵌入可作为有效归纳先验，在标签稀缺下的多种下游任务（LoS/NLoS分类、TA估计和波束选择）中一致优于基线模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes incorporating channel configuration information into radio foundation model pre-training, demonstrating that the resulting CFG-enriched embeddings serve as effective inductive priors and consistently outperform baselines on downstream tasks such as LoS/NLoS classification, TA estimation, and beam selection under label scarcity.
